hero.title: Web Harmonium Online
hero.description: A browser-based web harmonium tool with keyboard shortcuts, touch controls, Sargam labels, and simple practice features for beginners.

features.title: Built for Web Harmonium Practice
features.description: This page keeps the product focused on fast play, clear note labels, and practical beginner practice.

items.title: Instant Play
items.description: Users should be able to start pressing notes immediately without a login wall.

items.title: Useful Controls
items.description: Octave, transpose, and label toggles help learners match the instrument to their practice style.

items.title: Learning Support
items.description: Notes, keyboard guidance, and tutorial content help beginners understand what they are playing.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.description: Answering intent clearly helps both users and search engines.

items.question: Do I need to download anything?
items.answer: No. The goal is to keep the harmonium fully usable in the browser.

items.question: Do I need an account first?
items.answer: No. The core playing experience is open so you can start practicing immediately.

items.question: Why show Sargam and western labels?
items.answer: Because learners come from different notation systems, and the same page should support both.

cta.title: Open the Tool and Start Practicing
cta.description: Use the homepage instrument first, then explore notes, keyboard mapping, and beginner tutorials.
